# This folder stores trained ML artifacts.
# Files added after Phase 2 train.py runs:
#   demand_pipeline.joblib   — trained scikit-learn Pipeline
#   metrics.json             — all model scores (generated by code)
#   feature_importance.json  — XGBoost feature importances
#   feature_columns.json     — ordered list of feature names
#   category_values.json     — valid category values for dropdowns
#   model_card.md            — model documentation
#
# *.joblib files are in .gitignore (large binary, regenerate with train.py)
